name: copy-command-section
purpose: A command or agent prompt with a copy button, under hero or section copy ("npm create azion", "Ask your agent to …"). With `shell` the command is one line in a large `InputGroup`, a `$` prompt leading it and an end fade when it scrolls; without it the prompt is a read-only block that wraps, so the reader sees every word they copy. From the design sample's site `CopyCommandSection`.
useWhen: Use CopyCommandSection for a one-line command or agent prompt with a copy button on a marketing page.
The one command that starts a product, beside or instead of a call to action.
A prompt to paste into an AI agent (`shell` off).
avoidWhen: For several lines or output — use `CodeBlock` or `CliTerminalSection`.
bestPractices: One line that works when pasted as is.
Place it in a hero or module-header actions slot.

props.name: value
props.doc: Text on the line, copied as written.

props.name: shell
props.doc: Draws the shell prompt before the text; turn off for a prompt meant for an agent.
